host_pcb_constraints_summary: External pull-up resistor on R/B_n (typ. 1-10 kΩ); required because R/B_n is open-drain.
External ZQ calibration reference resistor RZQ (typ. 300 Ω ±1 %) tied between each ZQ pin and Vss.
VREFQ supply (≈ 0.5 × VccQ ±2 %) for NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 single-ended input thresholds.
Bypass capacitor on Vcc + VccQ + Vpp (if used) close to each NAND package.
Signal-integrity routing for NV-DDR2 (800 MT/s) and NV-DDR3 (1.2 GT/s): controlled impedance (typ. 50 Ω single-ended / 100 Ω differential), length-matched CLK/CMD/ADDR/DQ buses, short stubs.
VDDi external capacitor for EZ NAND internal regulator stabilization.
Staggered power-up power switch (Section 2.14) for multi-target rails to bound inrush current.
ESD protection per JEDEC class for soldered-down packages; consumer-removable SD/USB form factors add card-edge ESD diodes.
fields.device_internal_constraints: Device-internal PDK / SDC / floorplan / layout / mask-level constraints are intentionally out of scope of ONFI 4.1. The spec defines only the host-device interface (pins + electrical levels + timing + protocol). NAND vendors deliver per-product PDK / SDC files separately to their qualified controller customers.
fields.notes: ONFI 4.1 Section 2 (Physical Interface) defines bus electrical parameters: absolute maximum DC ratings (Section 2.9), recommended DC operating conditions (Section 2.10), AC overshoot/undershoot envelope (Section 2.11), DC and AC characteristics (Section 2.12), VREFQ tolerance (Section 2.12.2), pin capacitance limits (Section 2.13). Section 4.10 adds capacitance requirements for NV-DDR family. Section 4.7-4.13 defines ZQ external resistor / drive strength / slew rate / impedance values for NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3. There are no internal SDC / UPF / DFT artifacts in the spec itself — those are NAND-vendor deliverables.
